verdict.rationale: Dover documents calendar integration ('Connect your calendar') and recruiter-side scheduling ('schedule candidates', 'Schedule or reject with Dover's default templates'). Nothing in the evidence shows candidate self-scheduling: no booking links, no availability pulled live from the team's calendars, and no timezone handling. Calendar connection and recruiter-driven scheduling are adjacent features, not the self-serve booking capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a recruiter, candidates self-schedule from live calendar availability — booking links tied to my team's calendars end the timezone email chains
